a: Pin dependencies and verify checksums when possible.
Reproducible builds make binaries verifiable from source.
Code signing verifies publisher identity of binaries.
Block merges when secrets are detected in diffs.
Separate prod credentials from staging and dev.
Break-glass accounts are emergency access with heavy auditing.
PAWs harden admin workstations for sensitive tasks.
Classify data to apply appropriate controls.
Retention policies define how long logs and data are kept.
